title_vi: Sàn chứng khoán độ trễ thấp: làm ít hơn trên đường găng

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a git fetch of the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Các cách giảm độ trễ hay dùng, với nguyên tắc đo trước.
Redis cũng chọn xử lý lệnh trên một luồng chính.

claims.evidence: The Disruptor technical paper read from a local clone; its lock-cost experiment and a thread hand-off test rewritten in C and run on one machine.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson (Markdown to HTML, optional sections open, 16 px side gutters) at each width: no horizontal overflow of the page or of any table; figure drawn by scripts/figures (viewBox width 320, smallest font 15 px) shown at 13.5 px effective at 320 px and 15 px at 375 px; every SVG text box inside the viewBox. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser passed. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: Locks are expensive when contended because the OS arbitrates with a context switch and cached data can be lost; incrementing a counter 500 million times in Java took 300 ms single-threaded, 10,000 ms with a lock, 224,000 ms with two threads and a lock, 5,700 ms single-threaded with CAS; the ideal is a single thread owning all writes to a resource.
claims.section: The Cost of Locks; The Costs of CAS
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of LMAX-Exchange/disruptor at commit c871ca49826a6be7ada6957f6fbafcfecf7b1f87, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: C, gcc 13.3 -O2, 500 million increments of a volatile counter: single thread 1.25 s; with an uncontended mutex 3.6-4.8 s; two threads with a mutex about 40 s; a single-thread CAS loop 6.2 s, slower than the uncontended mutex here.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): Intel Xeon 2.1 GHz under KVM; two runs.

claims.claim_vi: Round trip of one message between two threads pinned to two cores, 200,000 times: busy spin median 240-258 ns (p99 321-360 ns); mutex and condition variable median about 25.8 us (p99 about 60 us); on the same core median 4.5-6.2 us.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): C with pthread_setaffinity_np; two runs.

claims.claim_vi: Do less on the critical path: fewer tasks, less time per task, fewer network hops, less disk; critical path from the order manager through risk checks and matching back out; single server, shared memory event bus, single-threaded components pinned to CPUs with no context switch and no locks.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Bốn bước của đường găng, bốn cách làm ít hơn, và số đo về khóa và chuyển tin giữa luồng.
source_deviations: The lesson adds why locks are costly from the Disruptor paper and repeats two measurements; it reports that a CAS loop was slower than an uncontended mutex on this machine, unlike the paper.
Source's claim of microsecond latency for a modern exchange is not repeated; no real exchange was measured.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết tại repo này (gói L5), giữ ở trạng thái draft chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
